heading.title: Trade, Commerce and Intercourse within the Territory of India

article.title: Power of Parliament to impose restrictions on trade, commerce and intercourse
article.content: Parliament may by law impose such restrictions on the freedom of trade, commerce or intercourse between one State and another or within any part of the territory of India as may be required in the public interest.
article.html:
302Power of Parliament to impose restrictions on trade, commerce and intercourse

Article 302 · Part XIII

Parliament may by law impose such restrictions on the freedom of trade, commerce or intercourse between one State and another or within any part of the territory of India as may be required in the public interest.
